import unreal
target='/Game/SSPR_Validation/NS_SSPR_ProjTest.NS_SSPR_ProjTest'
rt=unreal.load_asset('/Game/SSPR_Validation/RT_SSPR_Occupancy')
comp=next((c for c in unreal.ObjectIterator(unreal.NiagaraComponent) if c.get_asset() and c.get_asset().get_path_name()==target and c.get_owner() is not None),None)
if comp is None or rt is None: raise RuntimeError('Actor component or RT missing')
set_ok=bool(unreal.ViewportService.set_realtime(True))
comp.set_variable_texture_render_target('User.OccupancyRTParam',rt)
comp.set_force_solo(False)
comp.set_age_update_mode(unreal.NiagaraAgeUpdateMode.TICK_DELTA_TIME)
comp.set_component_tick_enabled(True)
comp.set_auto_activate(True)
comp.reinitialize_system()
comp.activate(True)
info=unreal.ViewportService.get_viewport_info()
print('CURRENT_REALTIME='+repr({'setOk':set_ok,'realtime':bool(info.is_realtime),'component':comp.get_path_name(),'active':bool(comp.is_active()),'tick':bool(comp.is_component_tick_enabled())}))
